claim: During periods of extremely high demand, Fargate Spot capacity might be unavailable, which can delay Fargate Spot tasks; Amazon ECS services then retry launching tasks until the required capacity becomes available, and Fargate doesn't replace Spot capacity with on-demand capacity.

evidence.quote: During periods of extremely high demand, Fargate Spot capacity might be unavailable. This can cause Fargate Spot tasks to be delayed. When this happens, Amazon ECS services retry launching tasks until the required capacity becomes available. Fargate doesn't replace Spot capacity with on-demand capacity.
